Basel, Schweiz | Start: asap, spätestens 02.11.2026 | Duration: 9 months | Rate: CHF 140–160/h | Workload: 80–100 % | Onsite: 3 days per week

About the project
Our client, a globally operating life sciences group headquartered in Basel, is harmonising its cash management landscape. The legacy TMS will be replaced by SAP S/4HANA Treasury (TRM); In-House Cash and SWIFT connectivity are to be set up for 60+ legal entities.

Responsibilities
• Design of cash pooling (physical and notional) and in-house bank processes
• Bank account rationalisation (KYC, mandate management), currently 400+ accounts
• Bank connectivity via SWIFT/EBICS, payment formats (ISO 20022 pain.001 / camt.053)
• Support of the global liquidity planning roll-out (13-week rolling forecast)

Requirements
• Min. 7 years in treasury (corporate or consulting)
• Hands-on experience with SAP TRM / FSCM (IHC, BCM)
• Fluent English; German is a strong plus (Swiss German not required)
• EU/EFTA citizenship or valid Swiss work permit (B/C/G)

Please note: Contractors work either via their own AG/GmbH or via a Swiss payrolling company, which we can offer. Rates are all-inclusive (no expenses).

Tags: Treasury, Cash Management, SAP TRM, In-House Cash, SWIFT, EBICS, Liquiditätsplanung, Banking, Zahlungsverkehr
